events.body:
## Context

`scripts/extract-salary.js` feeds `build-jobs.js` but has no tests. `"Pay $45 - $60 per hour"` becomes `$45 - $60` with the unit lost, and k-detection looks at the whole match, so text like "New York" can wrongly multiply by 1000. Small and separate from the QA umbrella in #19.

## What to do

1. Add `tests/extract-salary.test.js` (require it from `tests/main.test.js`): USD/k/GBP/EUR, "to", "per hour" and no-salary cases.
2. Detect `k` per number; append "/hr" (or return null) for hourly ranges.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] New tests pass
- [ ] Hourly text isn't shown as a bare range
- [ ] `npm test` green

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-jobs
```

---
